file_access_grants_live_user_uidx.name: file_access_grants_live_user_uidx
file_access_grants_live_user_uidx.where: "files"."file_access_grants"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "files"."file_access_grants"."grantee_user_id" IS NOT NULL

file_access_grants_live_role_uidx.name: file_access_grants_live_role_uidx
file_access_grants_live_role_uidx.where: "files"."file_access_grants"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "files"."file_access_grants"."grantee_role" IS NOT NULL

city_requests_decision_shape.name: city_requests_decision_shape
city_requests_decision_shape.value:
("geo"."city_requests"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "geo"."city_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "geo"."city_requests"."decided_by_admin_id" IS NULL AND "geo"."city_requests"."resolved_city_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("geo"."city_requests"."status" IN ('ADDED', 'MERGED') AND "geo"."city_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "geo"."city_requests"."decided_by_admin_id" IS NOT NULL AND "geo"."city_requests"."resolved_city_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("geo"."city_requests"."status" = 'REJECTED' AND "geo"."city_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "geo"."city_requests"."decided_by_admin_id" IS NOT NULL AND "geo"."city_requests"."decision_reason" IS NOT NULL)

users_username_pair.name: users_username_pair
users_username_pair.value:
("identity"."users"."username" IS NULL AND "identity"."users"."username_skeleton" IS NULL)
          OR ("identity"."users"."username" IS NOT NULL AND "identity"."users"."username_skeleton" IS NOT NULL)

recovery_reviewer_not_subject.name: recovery_reviewer_not_subject
recovery_reviewer_not_subject.value: "identity"."account_recovery_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL OR "identity"."account_recovery_requests"."user_id" IS NULL OR "identity"."account_recovery_requests"."reviewed_by" <> "identity"."account_recovery_requests"."user_id"

generated.as:
"currency" || ':' || (CASE "account_type"
    WHEN 'PLATFORM_ESCROW_POOL' THEN 'PLATFORM_ESCROW_POOL'
    WHEN 'USER_ESCROW_LIABILITY' THEN 'USER_ESCROW_LIABILITY'
    WHEN 'BUYER_PROTECTION_FEE_LIABILITY' THEN 'BUYER_PROTECTION_FEE_LIABILITY'
    WHEN 'USER_PAYABLE' THEN 'USER_PAYABLE'
    WHEN 'PLATFORM_FEE_REVENUE' THEN 'PLATFORM_FEE_REVENUE'
    WHEN 'BUYER_PROTECTION_FEE_REVENUE' THEN 'BUYER_PROTECTION_FEE_REVENUE'
    WHEN 'SETTLEMENT_CLEARING' THEN 'SETTLEMENT_CLEARING'
  END) || ':' || COALESCE("owner_user_id"::text, "trade_id"::text, "payout_id"::text, '-')

ledger_accounts_scope.name: ledger_accounts_scope
ledger_accounts_scope.value:
CASE "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."account_type"
            WHEN 'USER_ESCROW_LIABILITY' THEN "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."trade_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_user_id" IS NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."payout_id" IS NULL
            WHEN 'BUYER_PROTECTION_FEE_LIABILITY' THEN "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."trade_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_user_id" IS NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."payout_id" IS NULL
            WHEN 'USER_PAYABLE' THEN "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."trade_id" IS NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."payout_id" IS NULL
            WHEN 'SETTLEMENT_CLEARING' THEN "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."payout_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_user_id" IS NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."trade_id" IS NULL
            ELSE "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_user_id" IS NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."trade_id" IS NULL AND "ledger"."ledger_accounts"."payout_id" IS NULL
          END

payment_attempts_succeeded_posted.name: payment_attempts_succeeded_posted
payment_attempts_succeeded_posted.value: ("ledger"."payment_attempts"."status" = 'SUCCEEDED') = ("ledger"."payment_attempts"."journal_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger"."payment_attempts"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

trades_parties_distinct.name: trades_parties_distinct
trades_parties_distinct.value:
"trade"."trades"."buyer_user_id" IS NULL OR "trade"."trades"."seller_user_id" IS NULL
          OR "trade"."trades"."buyer_user_id" <> "trade"."trades"."seller_user_id"

trades_parties_bound.name: trades_parties_bound
trades_parties_bound.value:
("trade"."trades"."buyer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trade"."trades"."seller_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR "trade"."trades"."status" IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_COUNTERPARTY', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED')

trades_fee_snapshot_arithmetic.name: trades_fee_snapshot_arithmetic
trades_fee_snapshot_arithmetic.value:
"trade"."trades"."fee_schedule_version" IS NULL
          OR ("trade"."trades"."item_amount_minor" > 0
              AND "trade"."trades"."buyer_protection_fee_minor" >= 0
              AND "trade"."trades"."commission_minor" >= 0
              AND "trade"."trades"."seller_proceeds_minor" >= 0
              AND "trade"."trades"."buyer_total_minor" = "trade"."trades"."item_amount_minor" + "trade"."trades"."buyer_protection_fee_minor"
              AND "trade"."trades"."seller_proceeds_minor" = "trade"."trades"."item_amount_minor" - "trade"."trades"."commission_minor"
              AND "trade"."trades"."platform_revenue_minor" = "trade"."trades"."buyer_protection_fee_minor" + "trade"."trades"."commission_minor")

trade_terms_delivery_address_shape.name: trade_terms_delivery_address_shape
trade_terms_delivery_address_shape.value:
"trade"."trade_terms_versions"."delivery_address" IS NULL OR ("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."delivery_address" ?& array['street', 'landmark', 'recipient', 'state_id', 'city_id']
      AND length(coalesce("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."delivery_address" ->> 'street', '')) > 0
      AND length(coalesce("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."delivery_address" ->> 'recipient', '')) > 0
      AND length(coalesce("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."delivery_address" ->> 'state_id', '')) > 0
      AND length(coalesce("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."delivery_address" ->> 'city_id', '')) > 0)

trade_terms_ships_from_address_shape.name: trade_terms_ships_from_address_shape
trade_terms_ships_from_address_shape.value:
"trade"."trade_terms_versions"."ships_from_address" IS NULL OR ("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."ships_from_address" ?& array['street', 'landmark', 'recipient', 'state_id', 'city_id']
      AND length(coalesce("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."ships_from_address" ->> 'street', '')) > 0
      AND length(coalesce("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."ships_from_address" ->> 'recipient', '')) > 0
      AND length(coalesce("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."ships_from_address" ->> 'state_id', '')) > 0
      AND length(coalesce("trade"."trade_terms_versions"."ships_from_address" ->> 'city_id', '')) > 0)

trade_terms_has_an_address.name: trade_terms_has_an_address
trade_terms_has_an_address.value: "trade"."trade_terms_versions"."delivery_address" IS NOT NULL OR "trade"."trade_terms_versions"."ships_from_address" IS NOT NULL
